project_type: PHP + vanilla JS web app, Tailwind CSS (CDN), Neon PostgreSQL, Leaflet.js
language: PHP 8+ (API layer), HTML5 + vanilla JavaScript (frontend), SQL (PostgreSQL)
build_system: No build step — raw PHP files served by Laragon (Apache + PHP). Tailwind via CDN. No npm build for main app. Workers folder has node/wrangler but is separate from main app.
test_framework: None — manual browser testing via Laragon at http://localhost/MBG-MONITORING/
build_command: N/A (no build step; PHP files served directly by Laragon)
test_command: Open http://localhost/MBG-MONITORING/ in browser. For API: curl http://localhost/MBG-MONITORING/api/<endpoint>.php
verification_instructions: 1) Open http://localhost/MBG-MONITORING/ — hero video and KPI metrics should load. 2) Open http://localhost/MBG-MONITORING/fitur/menu-hari-ini.html — no HTTP 500 in DevTools Network. 3) Open http://localhost/MBG-MONITORING/auth/login.html — video background shows. 4) For API endpoints, curl returns 200 JSON not 500. 5) Admin dashboard at /dashboard/admin/ must load and show SPPG count.
environment_constraints: Laragon must be running on port 80. PHP must have pdo_pgsql extension enabled. The Neon DB is remote (cloud) — all DB scripts connect over SSL. Never delete rows where source='MBGWatch' in the sppg table. Video background uses Cloudinary external URL — no local video files exist.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code patterns: PHP files use require_once for db.php/security.php, HTML pages use Tailwind CDN classes matching the exact color palette defined in tailwind.config inline scripts.
key_patterns: 1) All PHP API files in api/ must start with require_once __DIR__.'/../database/db.php' AND require_once __DIR__.'/../database/security.php'. 2) HTML pages in fitur/ must reference assets with ../assets/ prefix. 3) Dashboard pages use a client-side auth guard script that reads mbg_session from localStorage/sessionStorage. 4) Primary color: #001026 (navy), secondary: #395f95, accent green: #6ffbbe. Font: Plus Jakarta Sans. 5) All fetch() calls in fitur/*.html must use ../api/ prefix not api/.
directory_structure: Root: index.html (homepage), auth/login.html (login with video bg), fitur/*.html (public feature pages), dashboard/{admin,sppg,user}/ (role dashboards), api/*.php (REST endpoints), database/ (db.php singleton, auth.php, security.php, SQL schemas), assets/{css,js,images,videos}/ (static assets — videos/ is empty), map/index.html (Leaflet fullscreen map), data_sppg/ (JSON data file), workers/ (Cloudflare Workers JS — separate deployment), functions/ (Cloudflare Pages Functions JS)
